import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# Read input data
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')

# Identify numeric indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)
meta_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in meta_cols]

# Store raw values before imputation (for cluster profiles)
raw_values = df[indicator_cols].copy()

# Median imputation
imputed = df[indicator_cols].copy()
for col in indicator_cols:
    median_val = imputed[col].median()
    imputed[col] = imputed[col].fillna(median_val)

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled_data = scaler.fit_transform(imputed)

# KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)
cluster_ids = kmeans.fit_predict(scaled_data)

# Write city_clusters.csv
city_clusters = pd.DataFrame({
    'city_id': df['city_id'],
    'city_name': df['city_name'],
    'year': df['year'],
    'cluster_id': cluster_ids
})
city_clusters.to_csv('outputs/t13_city_clusters.csv', index=False)

# Write cluster_profiles.csv
# Mean of raw indicator values (before imputation/scaling), computed over non-missing values
profiles = []

    mask = cluster_ids == cid
    row = {'cluster_id': cid}

        values = raw_values.loc[mask, col]
        # Mean over non-missing values (skipna=True in mean handles this)
        row[col] = values.mean(skipna=True) if not values.dropna().empty else np.nan
    profiles.append(row)

profiles_df = pd.DataFrame(profiles)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans

# Read input data
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv')

# Identify numeric indicator columns (all columns except city_id, city_name, year)

# Standard scaling
scaler = StandardScaler()
scaled_data = scaler.fit_transform(imputed)

# KMeans clustering
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=3, random_state=0, n_init=10)

# Write cluster_profiles.csv

profiles = []

    mask = cluster_ids == cid

profiles_df = pd.DataFrame(profiles)
